text: いっぱい　もってる　じゃん

structure.jp: いっぱい　もってる

patterns.name: 〜じゃん
patterns.explanation: じゃん is a casual, slangy short form of じゃないか, pointing out something obvious: 'isn't it so?'. もってる　じゃん = 'you do have them, don't you?'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short form of ている, which here shows a lasting state. もってる = 'you have'.
